description: This file defines the ListShape class, which represents a 'list' shape in the AWS SDK's API modeling system. It extends a base Shape class and manages the 'member' aspect of list shapes.

classes.name: ListShape
classes.description: Represents a list shape in the AWS SDK, handling shape definitions for list-type API structures.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a ListShape with a definition and shape map, setting its type to 'list'.

methods.name: getMember
methods.description: Returns the member shape of the list, creating it if not already initialized; throws exception if definition is missing.
